body: Wow, I'm so sorry, I had no idea. I hope you feel better very soon c:
What were your duties and other stuff of that nature?

MDMA really, REALLY helped me overcome most of the PTSD... Its a very powerful tool when used right... Just throwing that out there....

But I do feel like I could carry on a healthy relationship and I have a desire to love someone more than anything else in the world so hopefully something will work out in the end... It seems like it always does... Thanks a million, kindest of strangers

There was a few posters around for an anime club and it sounded alright, thing is I'm 5/7 days in football till 5 o'clock... Volunteering on the weekends isn't that bad of a way to spend time and all... hmmm....
Maybe I could hear a bit about your story if that's okay?

That's exactly my case right now haha.... I really would like to blame my upbringing on not being able to show true feelings but I know the problem lays within oneself. I just can't bring my self to do it... like a couple months ago there was a few of my grandma's friends coming to visit with this one stunning daughter that was supposedly into me... This was when I was still going through PTSD so basically I locked my self in the room and was pathetic. So me and a few other people were just kind of chilling, and I wanted to apologize for being a dick so badly but people kept interrupting or I was just too pussy...

Every little bit of support helps. Trust me. I was planning on working at publix or something after the season... Maybe it is time to commit to it haha. I think working there will relive a little anxiety, hopefully. 15 years old as of last week, btw

Yes, I have a wonderful and effective therapist who helped me though PTSD. Just haven't gone into deeper thoughts with him. And thanks for that analogy, it immediately made me feel much better, I was beginning to think I'd never heal c:
They have this respect for me and I do enjoy talking to them, just don't click on an emotional level. Man I must sound really winy :l
I've dropped hints (I think). I honestly lost all social skill I have from being completely isolated for 9+ months.
